headline: Dell has added tools to its AI Data Platform that give AI agents shared definitions of company data and a way to search it, which it says cuts the cost of running them.
score_reason: Vendor feature update built on a media briefing; claims not independently tested.
importance_line: Large companies trying to move AI projects beyond pilots get new data tools from Dell, though the speed and cost savings are Dell's own claims.
summary: The Next Platform reports that Dell is adding agent-focused features to its AI Data Platform, including a shared glossary that gives business terms one meaning across systems, a knowledge graph that links related data, and GPU-based data processing. Dell executive Varun Chhabra said the aim is to stop AI agents rebuilding context on every request, which he said lowers cost, and Dell also released an open-source tool for testing storage performance.
notes: Based on a Dell briefing; speed and cost claims are Dell's.
